result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge, making the layout look cut off.

issues.description: The category row shows only a thin, empty portion of the next pill at the right edge, while the third card in “Fastest near you” and its title are sharply cropped by the viewport. Although these may be horizontally scrollable rows, the clipping looks accidental and obscures content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding, item width, and scroll snapping so the next item is either shown as a deliberate, readable preview or kept fully outside the viewport. Add a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance if needed.
